errors.text_span: 为线性刻度，范围从 64 到 768，数值间隔为 128
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the x-axis is a linear scale with a numerical interval of 128. The x-axis represents discrete, non-linearly spaced values (64, 128, 256, 512, 768).
The description completely omits the data point at x=128 (y≈0.749), describing the line as going directly from x=64 to x=256.
The F1 value corresponding to x=256 is stated as 0.750, but the plot clearly shows it is 0.754.
The F1 value corresponding to x=512 is stated as 0.753. The plot shows this point as the peak, at a value higher than 0.754 (approximately 0.755).
The F1 value corresponding to x=768 is stated as 0.751, but the plot shows the point is exactly on the 0.750 grid line.
